sources.name: Snell's law and the Fresnel equations, water n = 1.333 (visible, about 20 C)
sources.used_for: the deflection and the transmittance of a ray leaving a drop's curved face; the ring of total internal reflection past 48.6 degrees

sources.name: Marshall & Palmer 1948, The distribution of raindrops with size, J. Meteor. 5
sources.used_for: Lambda = 4.1 R^-0.21 per mm for the 25 mm/h storm; N0 = 8000 /m3/mm in the worked example only
sources.note: the project's cards carry their own fitted Lambda; the host's impingement comes from the card, not from this

sources.name: Spherical-cap volume of a sessile drop at a contact angle (Young's equation geometry)

sources.note: the 70 degree contact angle is STATED, not measured for any aircraft glazing
